title: No seás malo
desc: The first time you are teased, and the first time you answer
setting: Chino has been going at you all afternoon about the way you say one word.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.en: Ideay! Say it again, go on.

options.es: Ya, ya. Vos tampoco hablás tan bonito.
options.en: All right, all right. You do not talk so beautifully either.
options.feedback: Given back at the same size, and vos and hablás are exactly right with him.

options.en: I do not say it wrong.
options.feedback: A defence. Defending is what makes the teasing last another hour.
En serio changes the tone, and the table will change with it. Only use that when you mean it.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.en: Ha, look at the chele answering back!

options.en: I learned it from you, did I not?
options.feedback: You handed the joke back with his own name on it. That is the whole game.
True and pleasant. It does not land, but nothing is lost.
Chele is not an insult here, and objecting to it makes it your nickname forever.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: Este ya no se deja. ¿Quién te enseñó?
steps.en: This one does not take it any more. Who taught you?

options.es: Tu hermana, que es peor que vos.
options.en: Your sister, who is worse than you are.
options.feedback: Sharp, funny, and inside the line - family is fair game, mothers are not.
A fine answer that leaves the ball on the ground.
The one place nobody goes. That stops being a joke instantly.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.en: Ooh! That was a good one.

options.feedback: You kept the round going instead of standing on your win. That is how you get invited back.
It accepts the compliment and quietly ends the game.
Nobody wins these. Saying it out loud is how you get taken apart next Sunday.
